home.heroSubtitle: Instant AI crop disease detection, Grad-CAM visual evidence, and agricultural advice in your language.
home.step1Desc: Upload or capture a clear photo of the infected leaf.
home.step2Desc: AI runs multi-class disease detection and generates heatmaps.
home.step3Desc: Receive diagnosis, risk score, treatment protocols and prevention tips.
home.featHeatmapDesc: Proprietary Grad-CAM visualization shows precisely where infection is located on the leaf.
home.featChatDesc: Powered by Gemini AI, get instant expert-level answers on disease management and fertilizers.
home.featTrackingDesc: Monitor recovery curves and plant health scores over time with progress analytics.
home.featWeatherDesc: Correlates local weather conditions with disease spread probability in real time.
home.featLibraryDesc: Comprehensive reference library of plant diseases with symptoms and treatment databases.
home.featInstantDesc: Diagnosis results in under 3 seconds. Upload from any device in the field.
home.edgeTitle: BUILT FOR FARMS, LABS AND FIELDS
home.edgeDesc: BioScan works on any device — whether you are in a greenhouse, in a lab, or in the middle of a field with just your phone.
home.faq1A: BioScan currently supports Rice, Wheat, Sugarcane, and Cotton, with more crops being added regularly. Our AI model is trained on 127+ disease classes.
home.faq2Q: How accurate is the disease detection?
home.faq2A: Our AI model achieves 97.3% accuracy on our validation dataset. For best results, capture clear, well-lit photos.
home.faq3A: Yes. Your uploaded images are processed securely and never shared with third parties.
home.faq4A: Currently BioScan requires an internet connection for AI analysis. We are working on a lightweight offline mode.
home.faq5Q: What image format and size works best?
home.faq5A: JPG, PNG, or WebP images up to 10MB. Capture the leaf against natural light at 2-4 megapixel resolution.
home.ctaDesc: Upload a photo right now — no signup needed. Get AI diagnosis in seconds.
